config.validation: leave-one-day-out; candidate parameters are selected on two training days and scored on the held-out day

notes: Maker results use the same public-repo-style passive-fill assumption as round5_diagnostics.
Directional, residual, and ML taker tests pay the displayed spread by crossing the book.
A signal is considered robust only if the leave-one-day total is positive and every held-out fold is non-negative.
